The '''23rd Producers Guild of America Awards''' (also known as '''2012 Producers Guild Awards'''), honoring the best [[Film producer|film]] and [[television producer]]s of 2011, were held at [[The Beverly Hilton|The Beverly Hilton Hotel]] in [[Beverly Hills, California]] on January 21, 2012.<ref>{{cite news|last1=Kilday|first1=Gregg|title=Producers Guild Awards Name ''The Artist'' Motion
